title: Orbit and Gravity Again
author: Ansel Quintana
blurb: Yara Winterbourne, a decommissioned war android paying off its debts, maintains the beacon nobody remembers commissioning. But when gravity flickers across the entire system for exactly nine seconds, they discover that staying invisible was never really an option. Now they must deliver a message that will end the war — or start it, and time is already running out.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
